rv.q: Urgent and affecting, if heavy-handed climate-change drama

Not long after, as a Scouser, you’ll hear of a lost underwater city, well, village, the local Atlantis. Nearly 150 years ago, the then thriving city of Liverpool decided that it liked the super soft Welsh water (it is really, really good) and built a reservoir in Powys with that now long gone confidence/bull-headedness of the Victorian Age.
